title: Senior Brand Manager
motivazione: Senior Brand Manager per la categoria Aperitivi di un gruppo spirits: strategie di brand, piani annuali, budget, comunicazione integrata e raccordo con Sales e Trade Marketing On/Off Trade. Brand, budget e team li hai guidati (Dimhora, 400k), ma chiedono brand management in FMCG strutturato, preferibilmente beverage e spirits, che non hai: gap biografico, non formale. Il ruolo è marketing tradizionale e poco digitale, e la RAL non è indicata.

Principali responsabilità La risorsa avrà la responsabilità di definire e implementare le strategie di marketing dei brand assegnati, garantendo coerenza tra posizionamento, obiettivi di business e iniziative di sviluppo della categoria. In particolare, si occuperà di: Definire e implementare la strategia di marketing dei brand della categoria Aperitivi, con l'obiettivo di rafforzarne il posizionamento, la rilevanza per il consumatore e la competitività sul mercato. Guidare progetti di rilancio, riposizionamento e valorizzazione dei marchi, identificando nuove opportunità di crescita e sviluppo. Elaborare e gestire i piani di marketing annuali e pluriennali, assicurando il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di business, di quota di mercato e di marginalità. Sviluppare strategie di comunicazione integrate, coordinando campagne advertising, attività digital e social, PR, eventi e iniziative di brand activation. Monitorare l'evoluzione del mercato, i trend di consumo, il comportamento dei consumatori e le attività dei competitor, individuando insight utili a orientare le scelte strategiche. Collaborare con le funzioni Sales e Trade Marketing per sviluppare iniziative commerciali e promozionali coerenti con il posizionamento dei brand, con particolare attenzione ai canali On Trade e Off Trade. Identificare e sviluppare opportunità di innovazione di prodotto, packaging e occasioni di consumo, contribuendo all'evoluzione del portafoglio. Gestire il budget marketing, monitorando gli investimenti, l'efficacia delle iniziative e il ritorno economico delle attività. Analizzare le performance dei brand attraverso i principali KPI di marketing e business, definendo eventuali azioni correttive. Collaborare con le principali funzioni aziendali e con gli stakeholder coinvolti nei progetti di sviluppo della categoria. Contribuire alla crescita e allo sviluppo delle risorse del team, favorendo un approccio orientato ai risultati e alla collaborazione. Requisiti Il candidato ideale ha maturato una solida esperienza nel Brand Management all'interno di aziende strutturate del settore FMCG, preferibilmente nei comparti Beverage e Spirits, sviluppando competenze sia strategiche sia operative nella gestione e valorizzazione di marchi riconosciuti. Sede di lavoro: Milano Compensation: da valutare sulla seniority della candidatura Rif. title: Senior Marketing Manager, Merchant Marketing, IT
motivazione: Senior Merchant Marketing Manager a Milano in Deliveroo: strategia di co-marketing con partner, budget da allocare e KPI, in un contesto e-commerce/marketplace che conosci bene (Lesson Boom, Audio Effetti). Gap: chiedono 7-8 anni in trade/partner marketing e il coinvolgimento nelle trattative commerciali con ristoranti e grocery.
testo_completo: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. At Deliveroo, Marketing plays a key role in driving growth and shaping how customers experience our brand. We work across local and global teams, combining strategic thinking, creativity and a strong understanding of e-commerce to solve business challenges and deliver best-in-class marketing campaigns. If you’re entrepreneurial, hands-on and passionate about building brands and driving growth in a fast-paced environment, this is the team for you. We’re looking for a Senior Merchant Marketing Manager to join our Milan team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us shape, scale, and optimize our Merchant Marketing strategy and lead co-marketing initiatives with our key partners, driving mutual growth and maximizing brand visibility across Italy. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be joining the Merchant Marketing team. This team bridges the gap between our commercial business partners and our marketing engine, creating high-visibility marketing collaborations that delight customers and accelerate marketplace performance through partner growth. As a Senior Merchant Marketing Manager, you’ll shape the long-term direction of Merchant Marketing in Italy and lead one of the team’s key workstreams, working in close partnership with Commercial. Here’s what your role might look like: Own and evolve the Merchant Marketing strategy: Maintain and adapt our Merchant Marketing framework so it stays relevant and fit for purpose as business needs change. You’ll work with Marketing and Commercial leadership to translate marketing and commercial objectives into clear priorities, partner segmentation and plans, ensuring the framework never becomes outdated and always supports growth. Partner with Commercial on partner negotiations: Be directly involved in commercial negotiations with key restaurant and grocery partners, shaping marketing commitments and ensuring they are ambitious, mutually beneficial and aligned with Deliveroo’s strategic priorities. Lead and drive your Merchant Marketing workstream: Take ownership of your area by setting priorities, providing direction and ensuring high-quality execution. You’ll coordinate and guide the work of cross-functional team members, align stakeholders around shared objectives and influence others to drive projects forward, even without direct reporting lines. You’ll also need to be comfortable rolling up your sleeves and stepping into hands-on execution when needed, while ensuring alignment with the broader Merchant Marketing & Promo team. Manage senior stakeholders: Act as a trusted marketing counterpart for senior Commercial and Marketing leaders, and as a senior point of contact for partners, aligning on joint roadmaps, building long-term relationships and influencing decisions at leadership level. Drive performance and investment decisions: Define the success metrics for your workstream, review results with your team using data-driven insights, and steer how marketing budgets are allocated across partners and initiatives to maximize shared ROI. Guide and localize global initiatives: Act as the local strategic lead for global campaigns and initiatives, adapting them where required so they fit the local Merchant Marketing strategy. You’ll partner with central teams to make sure global programs deliver impact in the Italian market and stay consistent with our local priorities. What You’ll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: 7-8 years of experience in Trade, Partner or Merchant Marketing within fast paced environments across FMCG, e-commerce, tech or retail, with a proven track record of defining and delivering successful co-marketing strategies and campaigns at scale. Strong understanding of the Italian commercial landscape: Deep familiarity with regional consumer behaviors, retail promotions, and local media channels across major Italian cities, and the ability to turn market insight into long-term strategy. Proven people leadership experience: Experience managing and developing teams, setting direction and quality standards, and coaching team members to grow and deliver. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with experience supporting or leading commercial negotiations with enterprise partners and aligning senior Commercial and Marketing leadership. Strategic mindset with commercial acumen: Ability to build and evolve marketing frameworks in line with business objectives, and to interpret data to evaluate effectiveness and guide budget allocation and investment decisions. Autonomous and adaptable leader: Comfortable navigating constant change, making sound decisions in a fast-paced environment and taking ownership of outcomes in ambiguous situations. Fluency in both English and Italian: Full professional proficiency in both written and spoken languages to ensure seamless collaboration across local and global team structures. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Compensation National Collective Agreement (CBA): CCNL Commercio e Terziario Classification Level: Livello 1 The salary range for this role is €56,000 – €70,000 gross per year. The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed above and is determined based on a number of job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. This position is not eligible for consideration for an equity/RSU grant. To learn more about our benefits, please do not hesitate to bring this up with your Talent Acquisition Partner! If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Brand Manager, Dermatology Skincare & Consumer Products
motivazione: Brand Manager Dermatology Skincare (Cetaphil, Benzac) a Milano: piano promozionale, budget, agenzie e canali fisici e digitali, e il lavoro e' centrato su marketing e digitale. Gap: chiedono 5-8 anni di brand management in pharma/FMCG dermocosmetico e una matrix organization, che e' settore e non requisito formale.
testo_completo: Whether it's the unique breadth of our integrated offering that covers Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology products; or our commitment to recognizing and rewarding people for the contribution they make - working here isn't like anywhere else. At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact. Job Title: Brand Manager, Dermatology Skincare & Consumer Products Location: Milano, Italia. Hybrid Job Description The Brand Manager, Dermatology Skincare & Consumer Products or Cx Brand Manager will help translate the strategy for Consumer brands (Cetaphil, Benzac, Onilaq) into a local market plan to maximize brand value, achieve sales, profitability, and market share targets, and manage the local marketing mix within the budget. Additionally, it involves exploring new market opportunities, understanding the consumers and patients journey, monitoring the market, and creating action plans, also towards an integrated approach. All actions must comply with national laws (like Law 231 and D.lgs 81/08), Galderma's Code of Ethics, Pharma Industry Laws (including Farmindustria Code), and any other relevant codes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and working instructions. Key Main Responsibilities Develop effective promotional and communication plan for Cx portfolio tailored to each channel in conformity with objectives and global guidelines, collaborating with trade marketing specialist. Responsible for the management of the budget, keeping it under control Analyze market data, competitive intelligence, and consumers/HCPs insights to refine tactical execution - and collaborate for forecasting of product demand, with Sales, Market Intelligence and Supply Drive customer engagement to win at shelf - both physical and digital Build and monitor the sampling strategy Creates and adapt promotional materials, cooperating with agencies, and in collaboration with internal stakeholders Strictly collaborate with agencies and internal shareholders for Media Strategies, and coordinate assets localization and creation Be a key point of reference for Sales and strictly collaborate with Medical team Actively collaborate cross-function and cross-BUs, for Integrated Dermatology Strategies (IDS) Skills & Qualifications University Degree with a Marketing/Economic background 5 to 8 years experience in Marketing (Product/Brand Management) of Pharma/FMCG industry (consumer focus / dermo-cosmetic experience) Strong practical knowledge or experience in Sales in Pharma is a plus Proven experience in marketing rounded role, mixing qualitative and analytics tasks Sound Digital experience and knowledge Knowledge of Medical Visit strategy and congresses is considered a plus Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in cross-functional collaboration. Fluent in Business English (Italian mother tongue preferably) Office tools Veeva Vault knowledge (nice to have) Previous experience working in a matrix organization with international exposure This position has an indicative Annual base salary range of 48.600 to 59.400 EUR per annum based on the requirements of the role. In addition, the role is also eligible for incentive compensation and benefits commensurate with the role that apply: company car, healthcare plan, pension fund, meal vouchers Please note that the final compensation offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on individual qualifications, relevant experience, skills, and demonstrated capabilities, as well as internal equity considerations.
